note: “Look what I speak” means “whatever I say”; misread as the interjection “Look,”.
Invented stage direction “[To Gaunt.]” not in the original.
Rhetorical question split into a stiff statement plus a question with an unclear referent ('any such thing'); rejoined as one clear question.
'double-fatal yew' wrongly glossed: a graveyard tree does not kill; yew is deadly as poison and as bow wood
Reversed action: the knee kisses the ground, not the ground the cousin.
Invented details not in the original direction (Westminster Hall, “young” Percy); stiff phrasing.
Garbled syntax: 'all of you who stand… some of you wash' has no main clause.
Wrong/ambiguous referent: 'it' now reads as the mirror; it is Richard's face that is bankrupt of majesty.
'For why' means 'because'; rendered as interjection 'Why,' losing the causal link.
Wrong fact: makes Hallowmas the shortest day; original gives two alternatives (Hallowmas, or the shortest day).
Redundant, stiff phrasing (“Leave us, and leave us”).
Misplaced modifier: says the promise was made while reading; original means remember, as you read, the promise already made.
Garbled relative clause (“begging you who has never begged”).
Garbled “saw it”: what the Groom saw (Bolingbroke riding Barbary) is split off as a separate sentence with dangling “it”.
“Would he not stumble?” is an indignant wish (couldn’t he have stumbled?), not a factual question; groom just said the horse went proudly.
